stories.title: Portland drains new Washington Park reflecting pool to investigate major leak
stories.summary: The pool could remain empty while crews work to pinpoint the source of a leak that has been wasting an estimated 68,000 gallons of water a day.

stories.title: Committee finalizes recommendations for Interstate Bridge tolls, suggesting range of $1.55 to $3.90
stories.summary: The scenarios suggested by the Bi-State Tolling Subcommittee are not final; the two state transportation commissions will set the official rates late next year.

stories.title: Families of Nippon Dynawave tank failure victims react to workplace safety investigation findings
stories.summary: Family members of the deadly tank failure victims reacted to new safety investigation findings, and push for accountability and stronger workplace protections.

stories.title: Nippon Dynawave fined over $10M for 'egregious' safety violations; investigators refer criminal charges
stories.summary: The findings of the workplace safety investigation are part of a larger effort to uncover exactly what went wrong that day.

stories.title: Oregon joins lawsuit alleging Dollar General upcharged customers at the register
stories.summary: The complaint from numerous states and the Federal Trade Commission alleges that items marked at one price in the store would then ring up for more.

stories.title: Vancouver man accused of trying to poison his allergic wife with gluten
stories.summary: The woman told police that she'd been making gluten-free bread when she got into an argument with her husband, James Jacobsen, about his bag of burritos.

stories.title: Lawsuit: Teen at Mount Hood boarding school for athletes slept with a belt under his pillow after daily rape threats
stories.summary: A mother’s suit alleges students filmed a sexual assault on her 15-year-old son and that staff knew. Sheriff’s detectives found insufficient evidence of a crime.

stories.title: Multnomah County flavored tobacco ban takes effect next year after court approval
stories.summary: A ban on flavored nicotine and tobacco products starts in Multnomah County in January. The ban will be phased in until 2028, when full enforcement begins.

stories.title: ODOT says highway fund revenues are verifiably on the decline, pinching state and local transportation budgets
stories.summary: When ODOT first began sounding the alarm a few years back, fuel tax revenue was only slowing in growth. Now, they say, revenues are actually down year-over-year.

stories.title: 'We're all hurting': Mother of man killed along Eastbank Esplanade pleads for the public's help
stories.summary: Colton Mincey, 35, was fatally shot on Portland's Eastbank Esplanade on Aug. 26. His family is still waiting for answers.

stories.title: Berkly Catton scores a hat trick as the Kraken beat the Canucks 5-1
stories.summary: Berkly Catton got his first NHL hat trick, helping the Seattle Kraken end a three-game losing streak with a 5-1 victory over the Vancouver Canucks.

stories.title: King tides return to the Oregon Coast next week
stories.summary: Visitors have the chance to catch the high tides from Sunday, Nov. 23, to Thursday, Nov. 27.
